rationale: Quickstart declares FPT/GHEC/GHES but unconditionally creates username.github.io user site and visits that cloud URL. GHES overview uses isolation-specific paths and managed users cannot personal-site publish; the generic tutorial is not a verified deployment adapter for all declared platforms. New repository UI names username.github.io, chooses repository visibility, initializes README and creates repo. Example username/Octocat are placeholders; no repository creation, identity change or consumer rename authorized or executed. Repository visibility choice must not be treated as published-site visibility. Pages capability plan include and GHEC private/managed-user conditions separately apply; sensitive source content must not be exposed based on private-repository assumption. Branch publication requires settings/Pages Deploy from a branch and selected publishing source. Dropdown existence/selection is not successful build/deployment or actual site access evidence; guide omits explicit save step here rather than proving implicit deployment behavior. README is optional site content in this quickstart; keeping defaults does not demonstrate project-specific truth, rights or generated content safety. A promised site visit is not observed deployed content. Publication may take up to ten minutes after changes pushed; this is stated propagation timing, not completed timed run, deployment timeout or guarantee all sites become available. Title/description changes use _config.yml; source first says create it if absent then says it already contains a theme line. Preserve this conditional assumption discrepancy instead of treating new empty config as pre-themed. jekyll-theme-minimal/title/description YAML is illustrative theme configuration, not approved pinned dependency or current recommendation. File edit/Commit changes is procedure; no site configuration modified. Closing successfully published prose assumes completion of prior steps, not an execution receipt. Content/custom-domain outbound links remain separately scoped; no rights clearance, accepted policy, source/published completeness certification or native rollout follows. Full file and required include/variable context read; source tutorial is not actual publication assurance.
